text:
Ethan (Finance): Flagging INV-2210 for ACME-SWITCH. They were billed pro-rated reserved commit top-up but customer says commit scaling rule should have applied, so burst charges look incorrect.

Maya (Billing): Which scaling rule? commit_auto_scale? need the rule id and timeframe.

Ethan (Finance): Rule: commit_auto_scale_v2. Applied 2026-05-03 00:00 UTC. Invoice shows prorate for 5,000 extra hours billed as burst.

```
account,period,reserved_before,reserved_after,prorated_charge,burst_hours
acme-switch,2026-05,20000,25000,$1200,0
```

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2210 generated for acme-switch on 2026-05-05. Total due: $28,450. Prorate line included.

Rafi (Platform): I checked autoscaler logs. The scale event was acknowledged by control-plane but the quota update job failed to write to billing metering by CRON job timeout. So platform accepted scale but meter never reconciled. Ticket INF-1317 opened.

June (Acct Ops): Customer reports they saw committed capacity increase in console and assumed billing would reflect new commit (no burst). They're upset about surprise prorate.

Maya (Billing): If platform signals commit increase but metering didn't pick it up, we shouldn't charge prorate. Propose reversing the prorate charge and issue a billing adjustment.

Ethan (Finance): Approve provisional reversal up to $2k for prorate. Need MB approval if > $2k. Current prorate is $1,200 so within limit.

June (Acct Ops): I'll draft the customer note: apologize, explain root cause (write failure to metering), confirm we will reverse prorate and issue corrected invoice.

billing-bot: Created ticket BLG-942: "prorate-reversal-acme-switch-inv2210" and linked INF-1317.

Rafi (Platform): Will push a fix to ensure commit write acknowledgement is idempotent and add a reconciliation job to re-run missed scales. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Maya (Billing): I'll issue credit memo CM-478 to zero out the prorate line and regenerate INV-2210. Hold collection until done.

Ethan (Finance): Thanks. Action items: Maya apply credit & regen invoice, June send customer note, Rafi close INF-1317, update BLG-942 when done. Close by 2026-05-07.
